name: Mercutio Eterna
original_name: マキューシオ＝エテルナ
source:
[url=/c12547]Romeo's[/url] cousin and best friend. 
A flashy guy with lots of charm who loves joking around and women.
He's older than Romeo.
He has lots of power for a vampire, but he is unceasingly loyal. 
He always acts alongside Romeo and cooperates to the best of his ability.
